'''Duroc''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean]] and part of a contingent of [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] hired by the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]] as security for a secret base in the [[Valsedian asteroid belt]]. The group came under attack by [[Dark Acolyte/Legends|Dark Acolyte]] [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] and Duroc was [[The Force/Legends|Force]][[Telekinesis/Legends|-choked]] and hurled against a wall with crushing force.
